text:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock the GA handoff checklist for SLA, provisioning, docs, monitoring, and pricing by EOD Wed. Can owners confirm gaps?
aj: I'm happy to own runtime SLA wording. Need clarity on p99 targets and what 'best effort' means for overload.
sophie: Docs owner here — I need a stable feature list and any admin UI screenshots. Also the public vs internal docs split.
ramon: Ops/infra: provisioning question — will Dedicated customers get pre-provisioned capacity or on-demand? This affects our capacity playbook and onboarding runbook.
tay: Support lead — please confirm oncall rota and escalation paths. Also need runbook stub for common SLA breaches and rollback steps.
maria: For p99 we were leaning 200ms for small models, 500ms for larger variants, with a 'graceful degradation' fallback to cheaper model when load spikes. Is that acceptable? @aj @ramon
aj: 200/500 sounds fine if we require autoscaling headroom and KV cache priming. Need a bullet in the SLA: 'Fallback to compatible model variants may occur during capacity constraints.'
ramon: Provisioning: for Dedicated GA we should offer two options: 1) Reserved pool (monthly commit) 2) Auto-burst (pay-as-you-go). Need billing entries for both and a clear provisioning API call.
sophie: Docs checklist I want from product/eng: short feature matrix, screenshots, expected perf table (p50/p95/p99), example curl for provisioning, and admin troubleshooting steps.
tay: Support needs: contacts for first/second line, severity classification (S0/S1/S2), runbook links, and SLAs for response/ack windows. I can draft templates once we have targets.
maria: Pricing: finance wants unit economics — token cost, hosting differential for quantized models, and a forecasted price tiers doc. @aj can you export a sample perf x cost matrix?
aj: Yep, will produce perf x cost CSV. Quick ask: how permissive are we on SLA exceptions for early customers?
maria: We can allow case-by-case exceptions with an approval flow (sales+eng+finance). Must be logged in the handoff doc.
sophie: Also flagging migration notes — customers moving from hosted->dedicated will need data residency checklist and a migration window suggestion.
ramon: Monitoring: we need per-route token latency histograms, error-rate alerts, capacity utilization dashboards, and a fallback-rate metric (how often we route to cheaper model).
deply-bot: (system) scheduled reminder: GA handoff doc review meeting in #product tomorrow 10:00.
maria: Thanks — I'll update the master handoff doc with these action items. Owners: SLA wording @aj, Provisioning + billing @ramon, Docs @sophie, Support runbooks @tay, Pricing matrix @aj + finance. Can everyone ack here when you put your PR into the handoff doc?
aj: Ack, I'll add SLA wording and perf/cost CSV by tomorrow noon.
sophie: Ack, drafting docs split and screenshots.
ramon: Ack, will add provisioning API examples and billing options.
tay: Ack, will draft runbook templates and severity ladder.
maria: Perfect. If any blockers surface, ping me. We'll gate GA on: SLA text + owner signoffs, provisioned billing options documented, public docs skeleton + internal runbooks, monitoring dashboards with basic alerts, and pricing tier draft.
